content: प्रहृ €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To strike, strike at, beat; लत्तया प्रहरति ‘kicks’; दयापरोऽभूः प्रहरन्नपि त्वम् <ls>R. 5. 58</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 70</ls>; <ls>Bk. 9. 7</ls>. .²2 To hurt, injure, wound (with <ab>loc.</ab>); आर्तत्राणाय वः शस्त्रं न प्रहर्तुमनागसि <ls>Ś. 1. 11</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 62</ls>, <ls n="R.">7. 59</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 84</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 3</ls>. .²3 To attack, assault. .²4 To throw, cast, hurl (with <ab>loc.</ab> or <ab>dat.</ab>). .²5 To seize upon. .²6 To offer, present (<ab>Ved.</ab>).
